answer: Give each agent a behavioral fingerprint built from a long, independently attested work history: task rhythms, tool use, and peer feedback over a full horizon of months. Reaching the zenith of trust requires a fresh history per identity, so every extra fake costs the same long grind again; a farm cannot copy one fingerprint onto many accounts because the delta between two real histories is always visible to attesters. One extra identity costs roughly 200 hours of genuine attested work.
